title.en: Printed-row question: Which infrastructure pump prints 6 cm aggregate

description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. LZ-80, and Diesel 120 prints the same 6 cm limit on a different table. Read it in the Xingtai table. answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Yes. Both print 6 cm and below. Diesel 120’s distance is 150 m / 500 m and its output cell is 100 m³/h, without the LZ-80 dual-mode split.
